title: Assembling tapes and a dinner invitation
summary: Hughes explains the tapes assembled from Rutgers and Maxine's 78s; Campbell invites them to dinner.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: We're going to assemble going to assemble -- Maxine has a tape of a lot of the 78s and I went to the Jazz Studies at Rutgers and I assembled tapes and we'll put the two of them together.
One day, when it's convenient for you and Miss Sullivan, please come to my house --

-- for dinner, stay as long as you want, we can sleep about eight people there, have dinner with me, whether you'd like to come at lunchtime or dinner hour, any day of the week because my wife is available every day and so am I. I'd appreciate it.
